newsitem.title: USA: BankUnited issues preferred trust shrs.
newsitem.headline: BankUnited issues preferred trust shrs.

text.p: BankUnited Financial Corp said on Thursday the company has sold 1,840,000 shares of preferred securities in an underwritten public offering of $46 million, including the underwriter's overallotment of $6 million or 240,000 shares.

The preferred securities represent interests in the assets of BankUnited Capital II, a Delaware statutory business trust, which has as its sole asset junior subordinated debentures issued by the Company.
The preferred securities were underwritten by Raymond James & Associates Inc and Ryan Beck & Co Inc.
The proceeds from the sale of the preferred securities were used by BankUnited Capital II to purchase junior subordinated debentures issued by the company, the company said.
Proceeds will be used by the BankUnited for general corporate purposes, including capital contributions to the bank to support growth, BankUnited said.
